channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: Nvidia said Thursday that Jensen Huang has resigned as president, CEO and director, effective immediately, after 33 years; its 8-K says the board accepted the resignation on 11 November. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO and stays CFO, Harvey Jones becomes the first board chair, and fiscal Q3 results stay on 17 November. Nvidia gave no reason; the exit follows the board's 8 November review of reports that Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort. Shares fell about 10% to 12%. Nvidia is also the GPU market's largest financier, with about $36 billion of cloud-service commitments plus stakes in and credit support for neoclouds and labs (TechCrunch), so neocloud stocks fell with it. Nebius beat on Q3 revenue at $980.8 million but cut 2026 guidance to $3.0 to $3.2 billion because some third-party capacity slipped into 2027, raised 2026 capex to about $27 billion and guided $40 to $45 billion for 2027, 75% to 85% funded by prepayments and asset-backed debt. Live list prices held for a fourth straight day: 70 confirms, 0 ticks and 0 NEW, with Lambda H100 at $4.59 and B200 at $7.69.

item.description: Nvidia said Thursday that Jensen Huang has resigned as president, CEO and director, effective immediately, after 33 years; its 8-K says the board accepted the resignation on 11 November. Nvidia gave no reason; the exit follows the board's 8 November review of reports that Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort. Shares fell about 10% to 12%. Nvidia is also the GPU market's largest financier, with about $36 billion of cloud-service commitments plus stakes in and credit support for neoclouds and labs (TechCrunch), so neocloud stocks fell with it. Nebius beat on Q3 revenue at $980.8 million but cut 2026 guidance to $3.0 to $3.2 billion because some third-party capacity slipped into 2027, raised 2026 capex to about $27 billion and guided $40 to $45 billion for 2027, 75% to 85% funded by prepayments and asset-backed debt. Countries: United States: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO; CFO Colette Kress interim, Harvey Jones first chair; Q3 results still 17 Nov (Wire, 12 Nov, confirmed). United States: Nebius Q3 revenue $980.8 million; third-party capacity slips into 2027; 2026 capex about $27 billion, 2027 capex $40 to $45 billion (Wire, 12 Nov, confirmed). India: ReNew 1 GW Anakapalli data centre (Rs 67,000 crore) and CleanMax-Neysa 2 GW Kurnool compute campus announced at the CII summit (Wire, 12 Nov, single-source, MoU stage). Chile: AWS South America (Chile) Region open to select customers; more than $4 billion planned; GA by end-2026 (Wire, 11 Nov, confirmed). Saudi Arabia: Infra signs up to SAR 2.5 billion for HUMAIN: about 25 MW of GPUs plus grid sized for up to 1 GW (Wire, 9 Nov, confirmed).
